# Radoslav Radev Requires Activating Lats, Core, and Legs for Planche

Radoslav Radev requires squeezing the lats, core, and legs simultaneously to achieve a planche, stating that missing any one of these makes the skill impossible regardless of strength. [src: vid-G331KArPXnI @ 06:12]

## Details

- Without activating the lats (pushing shoulders down), you cannot lift your legs past advanced tuck planche. [src: vid-G331KArPXnI @ 06:12]
- A relaxed core makes planche impossible regardless of how strong your tuck or advanced tuck planche is. [src: vid-G331KArPXnI @ 07:13]
- Without squeezing the glutes, tights, and lower back to connect the legs to the upper body, you cannot achieve planche even with lats, chest, and core engaged. [src: vid-G331KArPXnI @ 08:06]
- Pointing the toes automatically squeezes the legs and is a useful cheat. [src: vid-G331KArPXnI @ 08:28]
- A relaxed core also risks elbow or wrist injury when the body drops down. [src: vid-G331KArPXnI @ 07:40]

## Evidence

- vid-G331KArPXnI @ 06:12 (Radoslav Radev): "if you don't activate the lats because you know my level i'm expert in planche and even if i'm on this level i'm trying to push without squeezing this muscle the lats i can't lift my legs"
- vid-G331KArPXnI @ 06:36 (Radoslav Radev): "you have to push your shoulders down that means you have to squeeze the lat to do it so you can't pass advanced plunge [planche] with this mistake"
- vid-G331KArPXnI @ 07:13 (Radoslav Radev): "if your core is relaxed let's say i'm doing everything else perfect but i'm relaxing my core that's not a planche i mean this is straight arm straight forward but that's not a plan guys if you don't squeeze the core you can't achieve the planche"
- vid-G331KArPXnI @ 07:40 (Radoslav Radev): "you can see how i'm losing protraction and everything else that i need for the planche and you can injure yourself injury your elbow or wrist when you go down like this"
- vid-G331KArPXnI @ 08:06 (Radoslav Radev): "the third mistake not squeezing their legs and they are not connecting their legs to the upper body and they can't do the planche even they have lats chest squeezed core pushing down high above the ground everything strand [straight] you never achieve the planche until you squeeze the glutes the tights and lower back"
- vid-G331KArPXnI @ 08:28 (Radoslav Radev): "if you point your toes you can see i'm pointing my toes like this i'm pointing my toes and automatically squeezing the legs so this is really good cheats that you can use"
